prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A three-pose character sheet showing exactly the same lovable honey-brown teddy bear made as a premium cozy felt appliqué with small coral and teal paper patches, stitched outlines, round ears, cream muzzle, warm dark button eyes, and one tiny marigold neckerchief. Three equal columns on one perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal background, one full separate teddy in each column at matching scale and identity with generous empty charcoal between them. Left: standing and giving a friendly wave. Middle: peeking over an invisible low edge with paws resting forward. Right: sitting and clapping with delighted smile. Full figures or complete intended pose visible, no overlap. No cell borders, labels, text, letters, extra characters, duplicated limbs, props, or cropped ears and paws.
